Hajduszovat Old Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Jókai Mór utca 17, Hungary

Not demolished. One of two Jewish cemeteries in Hajdúszovát, this older site was established in 1870 — the same year as the town's synagogue, since demolished — and presumably ceased operating once a second cemetery opened as late as 1919. No gravestones have been confirmed here, though this may reflect the site's dense, impassable vegetation as much as an actual absence of graves; the ESJF survey team found it too overgrown to properly assess. Unusually for this collection, Hajdúszovát's Jewish population remained remarkably stable across seven decades, hovering around 130 to 140 people from 1880 through 1941.
